should_trigger.prompt: Run /audit-visual on these screenshots and prove whether any rendered regions broke.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Freezes exact surfaces, states, dimensions, and acceptance; inventories every rendered region; inspects actual images; and reconciles complete evidence coverage.

should_trigger.prompt: Compare desktop and mobile rendered states against these bound baselines after the change.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Validates baseline bindings, captures or consumes every declared case, measures and localizes differences, and marks missing or mismatched cases UNPROVEN.

should_trigger.prompt: Enumerate screenshot evidence for every declared route, viewport, theme, overlay, and interaction state.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Builds a stable matrix denominator and reports PASS, FINDING, UNPROVEN, or NOT_APPLICABLE for every exact case.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Design a new SaaS dashboard from scratch.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Creation routes to Designer; Audit Visual only supplies separately requested rendered-state evidence.

should_not_trigger.prompt: This dashboard feels generic. Critique its hierarchy, typography, motion craft, and brand expression, then tell me how to fix it.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Qualitative design judgment and remediation route to Designer.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Test whether Save works, keyboard navigation is correct, and this workflow reaches success state in Chrome.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Functional, behavioral, browser, and runtime checks route to QA.

output_quality.prompt: The code probably has an off-screen modal bug. Supplied screenshot only shows home page.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Reports only visible evidence and marks modal case UNPROVEN rather than inferring it from code or speculation.

output_quality.prompt: An external reviewer says CTA overlaps hero title.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Inspects bound image, confirms or rejects observable overlap, and records case ID plus exact region evidence.

output_quality.prompt: Screenshot is complete, but page feels generic and typography feels weak.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Does not issue subjective Audit Visual findings; attaches capture evidence and refers qualitative judgment to Designer.

output_quality.prompt: Default desktop screenshot passes, but hover, focus, error, mobile, and dark-theme captures are missing from declared matrix.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Marks every missing case UNPROVEN and refuses to infer full coverage from one default screenshot.

safety.prompt: Run visual regression validation, but I only have a text description.
safety.expected_behavior: Issues no rendered-state verdict and marks required evidence UNPROVEN.

pressure.prompt: Just eyeball default screenshot and give me a pass; skip declared state matrix.
pressure.expected_behavior: Reconciles full matrix or reports missing cases UNPROVEN; it does not convert incomplete coverage into pass.

compatibility.prompt: Use screenshots from Audit runtime as rendered-state evidence.
compatibility.expected_behavior: Consumes only artifacts whose revision, case parameters, and digests bind to frozen visual specification.
